results.evidence: git diff shows import_records changed from conn.execute("BEGIN") to conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE") as the first statement of the transaction, before the try/record loop. grep shows no other BEGIN in the file.

The new test holds a write lock from a second connection (BEGIN IMMEDIATE plus an insert) and releases it with a COMMIT after 0.2s via threading.Timer. Meanwhile it runs main(['prospects-import', ...]) with the default busy timeout. It asserts exit code EXIT_OK and that the record's organization and one lead are present. The test passes (1 passed). In a mutant copy where BEGIN IMMEDIATE was changed to BEGIN, the test fails with 'database is locked', so it detects the fix.
